explication: Cortex lets security analysts submit observables for analyzer runs, inspect job results, and automate analysis through its REST API. The graph preserves analyzer and responder management, organization/user administration, worker discovery and execution, and the Elastic-backed persistence layer. The README documents product capabilities; source-index references and excerpts support selected internal links. Several controller-to-service and UI-to-API connections are not shown in the sampled code, so those relationships are omitted rather than inferred.
